title: New Arrival: Matte White Manhattan Toilets
bodyHtml:
Our Most In-Demand Toilet Range now available in Matte White

As one of our best-selling ranges, the Manhattan series has undergone a stunning transformation, now available in a sleek and timeless matte white finish.

Discover the Matte White Collection

Flawless Rimless Flush

Crafted with precision and designed especially for modern bathrooms, the Manhattan range boasts a rimless flush technology that ensures flawless performance without any splashing.

With a powerful yet water-efficient 4 star WELS rating, you can enjoy both efficiency and effectiveness in every flush.

Manhattan Wall Faced Pan in Matte White with Slim Flush Button in Matte White

The contemporary design of the Manhattan range features gorgeous architectural lines and soft angles, making it the perfect centrepiece for any modern bathroom.

Plus, with our exclusive CleanMax antibacterial glaze standard with all Studio Bagno toilets, you can rest assured that your toilet stays hygienic and bacteria-free.

Manhattan Rimless Suite in Matte White

Spy 80 in Matte White

Decus Bath in Matte White

Seamless Aesthetic Across an Extensive Range

Explore our range of matte white baths and basins to complete the look and create a cohesive aesthetic throughout your space.
